analogy.rationale: Autophagy inducers acting via SNCA (alpha-synuclein) modulate a protein with limited expression in these cell lines, so transcriptional responses should be weak; oxidative stress and mTOR inhibition are the pathways most commonly linked to autophagy induction and may show partial overlap, while proteasome/HDAC inhibition and calcium signaling can also trigger autophagy but with lower similarity.
